comparison.objective: Add and close a personal padlock through a free hole in an occupied group lockout hasp without disturbing the coworker's lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Shackle-to-hole alignment, constrained insertion, padlock closure, and preservation of an existing safety lockout.
comparison.success_condition: Purple lock closes through both hasp jaws and survives hasp/handle load tests; disturbing the existing lock or opening the hasp is zero.
comparison.reason: PR-262 tests safety-preserving lock installation and constrained shackle insertion. It has no selective loose-body separation or agitation component.
